# Fotik

> Your gallery fills up quietly. Duplicates, similar shots, screenshots, screen recordings, blurry photos and oversized videos pile up without you noticing — until your phone refuses to save one more photo.

Photo Storage Cleaner – Fotik — Clear space in camera roll. iPhone app, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806154654?pt=128839649&ct=ai_web

## Guides

- [How to Delete Duplicate Photos on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/fotik-app/delete-duplicate-photos-on-iphone): Find duplicate and similar photos and decide which to keep, using Fotik.
- [How to Delete All Screenshots and Screen Recordings on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/fotik-app/delete-screenshots-and-screen-recordings-on-iphone): Clear old screenshots and screen recordings in a few swipes with Fotik.
- [How to Free Up Space From Your iPhone Photo Library](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/fotik-app/free-up-space-on-iphone-photos): Find the biggest and most redundant files in your gallery and clear them with Fotik.
- [Why iPhone Storage Isn't Freed After Deleting Photos](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/fotik-app/why-iphone-storage-not-freed-after-deleting-photos): Deleted photos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days. Here is how to free the space for real.
